method: Controlled entropy through actual server start/move, serialized full-history validation, no database or production writes.
tests: Purchased origin is empty, x1, ten spins, no RNG or credit
Forged empty purchased origins are rejected before RNG
Three base tickets do not trigger and four or more award ten
Natural entry resets base x50 to bonus x1 and retains base payment
Free energy rises before payout, persists across free spins and resets on a new paid round
Energy without a winning ordinary group does not charge or pay
Every energy value is applied and spinner cells disappear with wins
Free retriggers are 3, capped at thirty awarded spins including final partial grant
Normal entry plus maximum free retriggers produces exactly thirty one history entries
Cascade limit pays twenty frames and counts tickets on the final unscored refill
Whole round cap stops cascade and free spins, pays remaining amount, suppresses ticket retrigger
Cap allocates a limited frame across simultaneous groups with no negative awards
Gravity preserves ticket order and uses only emptied cells for refills
All thirteen stakes scale normal and complete purchased settlement exactly
Self consistent active and complete x50 origin receipts are rejected
Forged counts, frame payment, gravity, award, multiplier and revision are rejected
Normal has no empty receipt and active or settled status must match continuation
Invalid stakes and settings are refused before RNG
